text.p: Belgium welcomed on Wednesday the overnight agreement between Israel and the Palestinian Authority over the West Bank town of Hebron and said its foreign minister would soon visit Israel to meet both sides.
"We are happy to see the peace process is back on track and going in the right direction," Foreign Ministry spokesman Andre Querton told the weekly press briefing.
Querton said Foreign Minister Erik Derycke would visit Israel later this month together with a delegation of Belgian parliamentarians and Development Minister Reginald Moreels.
Derycke hoped to meet Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Foreign Minister David Levy and Yasser Arafat, President of the Palestinian Authority.
